# Attention Is All You Need — Reproduction workspace

## What this is

A grounded reproduction specification for the Transformer: an encoder–decoder sequence transduction model based solely on attention. [Abstract: propose Transformer](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-300178317a9be800) [Conclusion: attention-only transduction](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-ed3351916654be2a)

## Read first

1. `SPEC.md` — method modules, equations, hyperparameters, data, metrics, risks
2. `results.target.json` — acceptance targets (must match SPEC)
3. `TODO.md` — ordered build and verify path

## Core claim

Attention-only transduction can reach strong WMT quality with high parallelization. Numeric gates: BLEU **28.4** and BLEU **41.0**, plus the **0.9** single-head ablation drop. [Abstract: En–De 28.4 BLEU](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-300178317a9be800) [Results: En–Fr 41.0 BLEU](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-60954fb1a674ba15)

## Declared code resource

Paper-declared (unverified here): `https://github.com/tensorflow/tensor2tensor`. [tensor2tensor URL](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-6c94a7e16226594b)

# SPEC — Transformer reproduction

## Scope

**In scope**

* Base/big Transformer encoder–decoder for WMT 2014 En→De and En→Fr
* Scaled Dot-Product Attention, Multi-Head Attention, position-wise FFN, sinusoidal PE, residual dropout, label smoothing, Adam LR schedule
* Decoding: checkpoint averaging + beam search as stated
* Optional: English constituency parsing transfer

**Out of scope**

* Re-implementing prior RNN/CNN baselines from scratch
* Appendix attention visualizations as pass/fail gates
* Cloning or running Tensor2Tensor without a separate request

**Core claim:** multi-head self-attention alone can drive competitive sequence transduction with strong parallelization. [Introduction: propose Transformer](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-60aecf560cb69ae7) [Conclusion: MT SOTA](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-f2f50ad1f79a767b)

## Method modules

### M1 — Encoder / decoder stacks (Fig. 1)

**N = 6** identical layers each; residual + LayerNorm: `LayerNorm(x + Sublayer(x))`; **d\_model = 512**. [Fig. 1](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-da5b7d30ede0fc58) [Stacked attention + FFN](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-948d34e9033c9b71) [Encoder N=6, d\_model=512](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-18350fa39bdabdbc)

Decoder adds encoder–decoder multi-head attention and masks future positions. [Decoder masking](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-be9344d005fb75ba)

### M2 — Scaled Dot-Product Attention (Eq. 1, Fig. 2)

```
Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(Q K^T / sqrt(d_k)) V
```

[Scaled Dot-Product Attention](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-e870cebf3b1ed063) [Eq. 1](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-abf10228ac7062a8) [Scaling rationale](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-d517b063a784e48e) [Fig. 2](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-6eda78c2ac183ca1)

### M3 — Multi-Head Attention

**h = 8**, **d\_k = d\_v = 64**. Three uses: encoder–decoder attention; encoder self-attention; masked decoder self-attention (−∞ on illegal logits). [Multi-head](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-8f309afc5b6f0964) [h=8, d\_k=d\_v=64](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-5a67a027ea5b3614) [Encoder–decoder attention](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-a294838979158a20) [Encoder self-attention](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-21ac1f34ab6caa7b) [Masked decoder self-attention](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-0461439223cb3ce6)

### M4 — Position-wise FFN (Eq. 2)

```
FFN(x) = max(0, x W1 + b1) W2 + b2
```

**d\_model = 512**, **d\_ff = 2048**. [Eq. 2](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-5c327aed3ebd032f) [FFN widths](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-1a272a6814e47fd7)

### M5 — Embeddings, softmax, positional encoding

Shared embedding / pre-softmax weights; scale embeddings by `sqrt(d_model)`. Sinusoidal PE; learned PE nearly identical (Table 3 row E). [Embeddings](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-ae81141c6fd4d563) [Sinusoidal PE](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-b7b475fc636bc084) [Learned PE](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-703be9a227e3bbc9)

### M6 — Optimizer and regularization

* Adam **β1 = 0.9**, **β2 = 0.98**, **ε = 10^−9** [Adam](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-da9e27e0c2088464)
* LR schedule Eq. 3, **warmup\_steps = 4000** [Eq. 3](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-954f9f236a2e50f5) [warmup](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-7b9ab0fb3e396d5b)
* Residual dropout **P\_drop = 0.1** (base) [Dropout](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-a6bd35e280ee30d3)
* Label smoothing **ε\_ls = 0.1** [Label smoothing](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-07970386a79b2c58)

## Data / inputs / outputs

| Setting | Dataset                               | Encoding               | Batching                         |
| ------- | ------------------------------------- | ---------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| En–De   | WMT 2014 English–German ≈ 4.5M pairs  | BPE shared vocab ≈ 37k | ≈ 25k src + 25k tgt tokens/batch |
| En–Fr   | WMT 2014 English–French 36M sentences | Word-piece vocab 32k   | same batching                    |

[Training data and batching](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-58f23864152069a2)

Hardware: 8× P100; base 100,000 steps; big 300,000 steps. [Hardware and schedule](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-aaa1688fd0ea5e8f)

Decoding: average last 5 (base) / 20 (big) checkpoints; beam size 4; length penalty α = 0.6; max output length = input + 50. [Decoding](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-873a5ee77cb2e6c7)

## Metrics and experiments

Target metrics (name, value, and condition must match `results.target.json`):

1. **BLEU = 28.4** under condition `WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task; abstract-reported model BLEU`. [Abstract 28.4](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-300178317a9be800)
2. **BLEU = 41.0** under condition `WMT 2014 English-to-French newstest2014; Transformer (big); P_drop=0.1; single-model`. [Results 41.0](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-60954fb1a674ba15)
3. **BLEU delta vs best multi-head = 0.9** under condition `English-to-German newstest2013 development; single-head attention worse than best setting`. [0.9 BLEU worse](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-2c5acb64be0e2502)

Fig. 1 / Fig. 2 constrain architecture. Table 2 / Table 3 / Table 4 captions are qualitative layout only (cell OCR empty — do not invent base-row BLEU or parsing F1). [Fig. 1](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-da5b7d30ede0fc58) [Fig. 2](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-6eda78c2ac183ca1) [Table 2 caption](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-49d5c3c0bbdbf347) [Table 3 caption](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-23cca5667197529d) [Table 4 caption](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-3785b8ec731e72bb)

Qualitative §6.1 note: big En→De also described as establishing 28.4 BLEU; numeric gate cites the abstract evidence unit that contains 28.4. [Results prose for En–De](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-a48a937a4ad7552e)

Abstract En→Fr **41.8** conflicts with §6.1 **41.0** — record as risk; acceptance uses **41.0**. [Abstract 41.8](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-300178317a9be800)

### Minimum reproducible experiment

**WMT 2014 English-to-German Transformer base BLEU** — train base Transformer on WMT 2014 En–De; evaluate newstest2014 BLEU. Exact base-row Table 2 cell is not available as text (OCR gap); use ranking claim that base surpasses prior published models, then strong-gate against BLEU **28.4**. [Base surpasses prior models](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-a48a937a4ad7552e) [28.4 target](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-300178317a9be800)

## Reproducibility risks

1. **Table 2/3/4 cell OCR empty** — base BLEU, FLOPs, ablation cells, parsing F1 are qualitative gaps until read from PDF figures. [Table 2](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-49d5c3c0bbdbf347) [Table 3](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-23cca5667197529d) [Table 4](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-3785b8ec731e72bb)
2. **En→Fr 41.0 (§6.1) vs 41.8 (abstract)** — reconcile before claiming exact Fr match. [41.0](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-60954fb1a674ba15) [41.8](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-300178317a9be800)
3. **Big-model Table 3 bottom row** not fully transcribed in prose — recover from PDF. [points to Table 3](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-a48a937a4ad7552e)
4. **Seeds / exact BPE scripts** — not fully specified beyond citations.
5. **FLOPs estimates** use assumed TFLOPS. [TFLOPS footnote](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-8bef3bbd430ab89c)
6. **tensor2tensor** is paper-declared only; API drift likely. [URL](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-6c94a7e16226594b)

# TODO — ordered reproduction path

## 0. Environment

1. Create an isolated Python/TF or PyTorch workspace (implementation choice).
2. Optionally inspect `https://github.com/tensorflow/tensor2tensor` as historical reference only. [tensor2tensor](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-6c94a7e16226594b)
3. Obtain WMT 2014 En–De (then En–Fr) matching paper preprocessing citations. [data](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-58f23864152069a2)

## 1. Core modules

1. Scaled Dot-Product Attention (Eq. 1) with masking. [Eq. 1](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-abf10228ac7062a8)
2. Multi-Head Attention (h=8, d_k=d_v=64). [dims](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-5a67a027ea5b3614)
3. Encoder/decoder stacks (N=6, d_model=512). [encoder](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-18350fa39bdabdbc) [decoder](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-be9344d005fb75ba)
4. FFN (d_ff=2048). [FFN](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-1a272a6814e47fd7)
5. Sinusoidal PE + shared embeddings. [PE](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-b7b475fc636bc084) [embeddings](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-ae81141c6fd4d563)

## 2. Training loop

1. Adam + Eq. 3 with warmup_steps=4000. [Eq. 3](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-954f9f236a2e50f5)
2. Dropout P_drop=0.1 and label smoothing ε_ls=0.1. [dropout](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-a6bd35e280ee30d3) [smoothing](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-07970386a79b2c58)
3. Batch ≈25k/25k tokens; base 100k or big 300k steps. [batch](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-58f23864152069a2) [schedule](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-aaa1688fd0ea5e8f)

## 3. Minimum reproducible experiment

**WMT 2014 English-to-German Transformer base BLEU**

1. Train base Transformer on WMT 2014 En–De.
2. Average last 5 checkpoints; beam=4, α=0.6. [decoding](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-873a5ee77cb2e6c7)
3. Score newstest2014 BLEU; compare ranking claim vs prior systems; do not invent base Table 2 cell. [base ranking](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-a48a937a4ad7552e)

## 4. Strong gates

1. BLEU **28.4** under condition `WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task; abstract-reported model BLEU` (proposed tolerance ±0.5). [28.4](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-300178317a9be800)
2. BLEU **41.0** under condition `WMT 2014 English-to-French newstest2014; Transformer (big); P_drop=0.1; single-model` (note abstract 41.8). [41.0](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-60954fb1a674ba15)
3. Optional: BLEU delta vs best multi-head **0.9** under condition `English-to-German newstest2013 development; single-head attention worse than best setting`. [0.9](thinkreader://paper/paper-a89f51c3ffa647c7?evidence=ev-2c5acb64be0e2502)
